note: Status per packet DRY family: concretized (this concept renders a native composition of the role), reused (consumed via shared data/semantics without new composition), not-exercised (belongs to another concept's surfaces). Variance notes are the anti-clone evidence: same product behavior, deliberately different composition.

entries.variance_notes: Destinations are numbered directory rows under Part headings with leader-style status column - a table of contents, not cards or tiles.

Notices group under ruled headings (Needs attention / Continue setup / Worth considering) with the status word set into the grid corner; recommended notices intentionally flatten to quiet single-rule entries.
A two-pane manual: 330px leader-dot TOC and a continuous numbered document with a sticky running header showing the live section number.
Results keep the same persistent Part headings as the browse listing and morph in place; manager-receipt results render as real anchors into the covering concept.
Numbered entries with dotted leaders and a right-gutter ink dot; deliberately no left accent bars and no pills.
The spy drives three projections at once: running header text, sliding ink marker, and replace-mode route updates.
The row is a book paragraph: label, prose, inline control, and a marginalia column carrying every status annotation - not a form table.
Shared chip silhouettes placed in the margin rather than beside the control, like editorial sidenotes.
Reasons are set as quiet sentences under the entry, never bare badges.
One dotted-border note pattern serves roles, models, goal route classes, BSD route, crew concurrency, and the permission origin example - proof the inspector is one family.
Managers are appendices of the same book: numbered sections, shared runhead, shared TOC - not consoles, sheets, or inspectors.
Resources are catalogue entries with typographic heads and disclosure bodies; detail stays in the flow of the page rather than a side inspector.
Health compresses to one status word or count in the directory column and TOC gutter; icon+count only where 302px demands it.
Numbered ordinance-style steps with a single current step; the cursor-cli offer adds the exact host/environment picker and the install-is-not-sign-in step.
Phases render as italic progress sentences in the card plus status-word changes; the verifying phase lists the seven conditions. Never a spinner-only treatment.

entries.concept_component: PMShell.toast over store receipt events + stub-note anchors
entries.variance_notes: Receipts surface as toasts with full sentences; cross-concept receipts are real links inside stub notes and search rows.

entries.variance_notes: Secrets appear only as vault references with a managed chip; no reveal or copy affordance exists anywhere in the concept.
Providers are catalogue entries under group prologues with two-word status pairs (auth word + readiness word).
Account cards carry identity, auth owner, isolation words, usage, and a bordered control strip; priority is adjusted with buttons, not drag.

One humanized card per installation: title, version chip, confidence word, update status; everything deeper waits in the Advanced resolution detail disclosure; actions come only from PMProvider.resolveInstallation.
Model rows reuse the marginalia grammar; depth/speed lives in a popover that stays open across both choices.
Evidence is a three-column table (capability, state word, source + time); the Haiku fastNote proves capability is never inferred from names.
Read-only projection with the Usage-page deep link; Settings never recalculates balances.
Gists read as annotated citations: quoted evidence with sources, version ledger, capsule preview with token estimate.
The model-facing capsule sits in the marginalia column as a sidenote - the concept's signature device applied to a new family.
Templates are appendix entries with a member table and ruled sub-heads; requested/effective concurrency reuses the shared inspector note.
Rules are numbered statutes with section marks; reorder is button-based renumbering with immediate re-evaluation; ELI5/Expert switches the statute language itself.
